controles.affirmation: Fusion Iridium signee le 28 juin 2026 : 27 $ en cash par action plus une composante en actions, pont bancaire de 3,6 Mds$, obligation de payer meme sans financement
controles.verbatim_source: each outstanding share of Iridium to be converted into the right to receive (i) $27.00 in cash ... a 364-day senior secured bridge term loan facility ("Bridge Loan") in an aggregate principal amount of $3,600,000 ... we will nonetheless remain obligated to complete the Iridium Transaction and pay the Cash Consideration

controles.affirmation: Operation conditionnee au vote des actionnaires d'Iridium, HSR, FCC, controle des investissements etrangers ; cloture au plus tard en decembre 2027
controles.verbatim_source: (i) the adoption of the Iridium Merger Agreement... by the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of the outstanding Iridium Common Stock; (ii) the expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 and consent of the U.S. Federal Communications Commission... (iii) receipt of clearances or approvals under other specified foreign investment... [and] if the Iridium Transaction is not completed by the end date (which is June 28, 2027), subject to up to two automatic extensions (to September 28, 2027, and then to December 28, 2027)

controles.affirmation: Iridium est une "societe de bien plus grande taille" que Rocket Lab
controles.correction_proposee: Rien dans le 10-Q ne compare la taille des deux societes, et les ordres de grandeur ne soutiennent pas l'affirmation (CA S1 2026 de Rocket Lab : 434,4 M$). Supprimer ou remplacer par "acquisition transformatrice au regard de la taille de Rocket Lab".

controles.affirmation: Neutron encore en essais de qualification, transfert au pas de tir vise au T4 2026, sans date de premier vol
controles.verbatim_source: Neutron qualification testing from large structures through to component level systems is ongoing ... Production of the Stage 1 tank is currently aligned with the target delivery of Neutron to the launch pad in Q4 2026

controles.affirmation: Le calendrier de Neutron "a de nouveau glisse"
controles.verbatim_source: While the window for an end-of-year launch date is narrowing, we are balancing the schedule of the first launch with entering Neutron into service as a system ready for full-scale production and high-cadence launch beyond flight one.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q ne documente aucun glissement, seulement une fenetre de lancement qui "se resserre". Remplacer par "la fenetre de lancement de fin d'annee se resserre, de l'aveu meme de la societe".

controles.affirmation: Tresorerie "plus que triplee en six mois" : 2 129,5 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre 828,7 M$ au 31 decembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Cash and cash equivalents $2,129,485 $828,660 ... Total cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities $2,387,590 $1,098,824
controles.correction_proposee: 2 129,5 / 828,7 = x2,57, soit +157%, pas un triplement. En incluant les titres negociables le multiple tombe a x2,17 (2 387,6 vs 1 098,8 M$). Remplacer par "multipliee par 2,6 en six mois". Le flux de financement de +1 523,4 M$ est exact.

controles.affirmation: T2 2026 : perte nette 49,3 M$ vs 66,4 M$, CA +62%, cash operationnel -134,4 vs -77,5 M$ (+73%), actions moyennes +22%, passif total 695,2 vs 602,6 M$, marge brute Systemes spatiaux 34,6% vs Lancement 42,9%
